name: play-starts-playback
description: The play control resumes playback, mpv's pause flag clears, and the position really advances.

steps.name: playing
steps.note: mpv always brings a fresh file up playing (PlayerDialog.cpp:1974-1976), so a player dialog opens mid-playback. The scenario therefore pauses first and then presses play, which is the only way to test that play STARTS playback from a known paused state rather than testing that a paused file resumes by accident.
First press pauses, putting the player into the state the rest of the scenario starts from.

steps.name: positionIncreasing
steps.note: Unpaused is not the same as playing: time-pos has to actually move. This is what separates a real resume from a pause flag that was merely cleared.

assertions.note: The core's own answer, read back from mpv rather than from the Qt cache that was written alongside it.
mpv_kind is named rather than guessed (ProbeManifest.hpp:59-61): read as a flag, a numeric property answers 0 and would make this pass on a player that never moved.

setPlaying is announced, not just recorded (VideoSurface.cpp:677-680), because the state pump compares the core against that very flag. Counting starts once the surface has settled, so this is emitted by the press under test.
